When a word is repeated again with vehemence in
the fane feen, it is called _epizensis_ This figure flews
the carefulness of the freaker, and his great concern
of mind about what he fears and therefore has a na-
tural tendency to exercise the attention of the audience.
It is fuited to exprets anger, furprizes, forrow, and fe-
veral other affiliates. As when Cicero would experts
his indignation against Anthony for having been the
chief instrument in bringing on the civil war, he fays
to him: _You, you, Authorism pulled Defer upon the_
court issue. It was that he tells Crafting in his first direc-
tive against him : _You lives; and live, not to lay afide_,
_but to paying your racked defying._ And when our Sa-
viour would expect his great concern and former for
the wandche of the Jews, he does it in this pathetic
manner: _O Jernjalem, Jerjalem, who kilitl the pro-_
_phs!_.
